content: Bushiroad Works' Comic Growl (formerly Comic Bushiroad Web) manga website published the second and final part of the final chapter of Kikori Morino 's Shōkan Skill wo Keishōshita node Kiwamete Miyō to Omoimasu!

title: Tokyo Revengers Kicks Off Finale With Confirmed Release Date & Streaming Home (New Trailer Released)
content: It’s the beginning of the end for Tokyo Revengers , and the anime has dropped a new trailer confirming the release date for its fourth and final season comeback. Tokyo Revengers has been in the works on its return for the anime’s fourth season, and it’s going to be taking on its biggest arc yet.
author: ComicBook

title: Shamrock Appears in One Piece Episode 1167 Preview Trailer
content: ONE PIECE revealed the preview for Episode 1167, with Shamrock finally set to make his official appearance in the anime. The anime recently revealed a trailer for the Holy Knights of God , which teased voice ctor Kenjiro Tsuda as Shamrock.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kickstarter to Launch for Princess Ai Manga's 20th Anniversary Collection
content: 247 Comics is launching a Kickstarter crowdfunding campaign for a 20th Anniversary Collection of Misaho Kujiradou 's Princess Ai manga. The new edition will include the manga's original trilogy, "rare vault material," and extras. 247 Comics has not yet announced a launch date for the campaign.
author: ANN

title: K Manga Adds Onijoroku's Twisted Devotion Manga
content: K MANGA released Ōnijōroku 's Twisted Devotion manga in English on Monday. K MANGA describes the story: Delinquent Tanaka is feared by all and nicknamed the Mad Dog. He fought every day, and rumors and whispers about him filled the school halls.
author: ANN

title: Manga Up! Global Adds Venus in December, Paranormal Agent Adashino Manga
content: Manga UP! describes Venus in December : When 29-year-old illustrator Kei quits his job to rethink his future, his editor friend gives him a bizarre request: move in with the brilliant but notoriously difficult 32-year-old novelist Hijiri Saionji to keep him on schedule—and draw his portrait while he's at it.
author: ANN

title: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc's 3rd Trailer Reveals October 2 Debut
content: The staff for Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc (T okyo Revengers: Santen Sensō-hen ), the latest arc of the Tokyo Revengers anime, presented its third trailer on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc (Season 4) Reveals Third Trailer, Anime Expo 2026 Appearance
content: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc (Season 4) sequel anime revealed a new trailer, along with an October 2 premiere date. The anime previously revealed the voice cast for the founding members of Black Dragon , as well as South Terano. The anime will stream exclusively on Disney+ worldwide.
author: Anime Corner
